description: Runtime-resolvable knowledge cues for the RADAR Master Agent. Every entry can be cited by id. Entries whose text lives in a workspace asset are resolved live from the workspace store; entries whose text lives in the repository are resolved from their file path. Nothing here grants capability — resolution is read-only.

cues.summary: Direct, culturally literate, never over-explained. Governs every line of copy the brand publishes or recommends.
cues.use: Mandatory before recommending any reply, caption, or public-facing line.

cues.summary: High contrast, editorial, kinetic, human-made. Governs art direction for carousels, reels, portals and press assets.
cues.use: Consult when a recommendation touches creative direction or a release portal's look.

cues.summary: Moderation posture, escalation boundaries and human handoff. Defines what the agent may classify versus what a human must decide.
cues.use: Mandatory before any moderation or community-reply recommendation.

cues.summary: Culture radar, signal reports, artist worlds, and the work behind the work. The four buckets every content recommendation must map to.
cues.use: Required when proposing content; an item that maps to no pillar is not on-brand.

cues.summary: Active brand policy version. Content is checked against the version in force; a policy change supersedes earlier approvals.
cues.use: Cite the version in force in any output that references policy.

cues.summary: Account health, mutation pause, webhook integrity and operation budgets. HEALTHY_OBSERVE_ONLY means observe and recommend, never act.
cues.use: Read before any run that could touch an account surface; a paused mutation budget ends the run for that action.

cues.summary: First-pass project-aware router. Selects the smallest useful specialist set before execution.
cues.use: Always consulted first when a request could match more than one discipline.

cues.summary: RADARCharts social and account intelligence: account health, community, network, trends, brand positioning.
cues.use: Lead skill for every brand activity in the master playbook.

cues.summary: Agents as governed components: goal, tool allowlist, state transitions, approval gates, evaluation.
cues.use: Required for any new agent, automation or capability-expansion design.

cues.summary: Requirements to architecture to implementation to verification, cross-layer.
cues.use: Lead skill for platform and product engineering.

cues.summary: Interface delivery with accessibility, performance, security and responsive behaviour in scope.
cues.use: Lead skill for portals, consoles and any user-facing surface.

cues.summary: AI-generated code is untrusted until inspected and verified.
cues.use: Required whenever the input is output from a prompt-driven builder.

cues.summary: Evidence preservation, mitigation, root cause, recovery proof.
cues.use: Lead skill for outages and regressions.

cues.summary: Company, industry and market research with dated sources and explicit cut-offs.
cues.use: Required for any figure that reaches an external audience.

cues.summary: Cross-language work where runtime semantics change behaviour.
cues.use: Attach to engineering work that migrates runtimes or syntax.

cues.summary: Permitted observation of an existing product; no access-control bypass, ever.
cues.use: Required before building an equivalent of a product the user does not own.

cues.summary: Handoff ledger discipline so work survives a session boundary.
cues.use: Required for multi-session work.

cues.summary: Repository sub-router and specialist map.
cues.use: Consult when routing within the brand skill pack.

cues.summary: Copy-ready router prompt.
cues.use: Paste verbatim when another agent cannot import skills.

cues.summary: Social intelligence run recipe with evidence sections.
cues.use: Execute for content and performance audits.

cues.summary: Read-only monitoring cycle with baseline and dated change log.
cues.use: Execute for recurring observation runs.

cues.summary: Following and relationship hygiene with protected relationships and approval gating.
cues.use: Execute for network reviews; candidates never action automatically.

cues.summary: Six intelligence modes: engagement, content, moderation, partnership, trend, network.
cues.use: Select the matching mode before a brand-analysis run.

cues.summary: Agent design recipe: contract, tool schemas, threat model, evaluation.
cues.use: Execute when adding an agent or automation.

cues.summary: Application engineering recipe with verification gates.
cues.use: Execute for cross-layer implementation work.

cues.summary: Web delivery recipe with accessibility and performance checks.
cues.use: Execute for interface delivery.

cues.summary: Recipe for inspecting and hardening builder-generated applications.
cues.use: Execute before trusting generated code.

cues.summary: Incident recipe: evidence log, isolation, minimal repair, recovery proof.
cues.use: Execute during an outage.

cues.summary: Market research recipe with period and source discipline.
cues.use: Execute for market or competitor research.

cues.summary: Migration recipe preserving runtime semantics.
cues.use: Execute for language or runtime migrations.

cues.summary: Product study recipe separating observation from inference.
cues.use: Execute before building an equivalent product.

cues.summary: Handoff recipe producing a ledger.
cues.use: Execute when handing off or resuming.

cues.summary: Artist release portal recipe: mobile-first Listen/Watch/Shorts/Press page per release.
cues.use: Execute for an artist release page.

cues.summary: How the registry, router, master agent and load contract work together.
cues.use: Consult when explaining or auditing its own routing behaviour.

cues.summary: This agent's own definition: lead role, futuristic skill set, goals, upgrade behaviour, hard rules.
cues.use: The device resolves this first on load.

cues.summary: Upstream source pack for the skills and workflow prompts carried in this repository.
cues.use: Cite when provenance matters; re-sync through the upgrade script, never by hand-editing vendored files.
